title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and reduce build matrix
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Our CI matrix and separate workflow files for lint, test, and release have become brittle and slow to maintain. This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows into a smaller set of unified workflows, reduces duplicated matrix entries, improves caching behavior, and standardizes release-dry-run and artifact publishing steps. Goals: 1) Reduce average CI runtime for PRs by collapsing duplicated matrix axes; 2) Improve cache hit rates for node/npm/pip layers; 3) Make release automation deterministic with a single release job that supports dry-run and canary flags; 4) Improve hygiene (remove deprecated actions, bump GH Actions versions). Summary of changes: Consolidated .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml into two workflows: .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint/test/build) and .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation + dry-run). Reduced matrix axes by defaulting PR runs to node 20 on ubuntu-latest and only expanding the matrix for nightly and release runs. Standardized cache keys for npm/pip/gradle using lockfile-based fingerprints, increased cache retention for heavy language caches, and added docker manifest cache for reproducible builder images. Replaced several deprecated actions, bumped popular actions to recommended semver ranges (@actions/checkout v4, actions/cache v4), and removed a legacy self-hosted runner label dependency. Release job now supports --dry-run and --canary flags and publishes GH release artifacts and container images in a single deterministic job. Rationale: This reduces duplicated CI work, improves cache locality across repos, and centralizes release logic to reduce incidents caused by divergent release paths.
